_about: Every hand-picked decision of the Hawking skater build, as data. blender_bake.py and build_mod.py replay it; change a number here and run build.sh. Lengths in metres; 'chair' points are in the wheelchair GLB's own coordinates (it faces -X there, Z up, ground at z = -0.477); 'world' points are in the professor GLB's coordinates (he faces -Y, Z up, his feet's floor at z = 0).

professor._delete_floor_box: the slab under his feet: six loose panels, 0.43 x 0.40 x 0.06 m at floor level in the rest pose. Loose parts lying wholly below max_z and wider than min_span go.
professor._bone_rotate_deg: extra rotation on top of the action, per bone, in the bone's local axes (x pitches most bones)
professor._ik: two-bone IK: the bone's tail (wrist / ankle) goes to target_chair; pole_world (optional) is where the elbow / knee points
professor._keep_rest_rotation: these bones keep their rest-pose world rotation after IK (feet flat on the footplate)
professor._log_bones: bones whose world position the bake logs after posing

chair._seat: chair-space seat_point lands on the professor's world seat_world (under his thighs)

game._units: THPS model units per metre (Hawk stands about 3300 units tall on his board)
game._ground_y: the ground in the board part's space (y down): the board pivot rides 216 units above it
game._front_z: which way along the game's z axis the model faces (the way it rides): -1, found in play (with +1 he rode backwards); the model is turned about the vertical, never mirrored
game._parts: the skater file's parts: 0-2 are the board and trucks (hidden in bails), 18 the head (the big-head cheat scales it); the mesh is spread over the others
game._anchors: per animation, what the whole chair follows: the board (default), or the pelvis carrying the board's riding pose (the bails, so the chair falls with the body instead of being thrown across the level)

mod.name: Stephen Hawking Pro Skater
mod.author: Bash Alarmist
mod.description: A professor in a powered wheelchair, who rides it like a board.
mod._front_model: the skater-select screen's model (up to 8 characters): the riding pose turned front_yaw_deg about the vertical so he looks out of the screen; the select camera sees the skater side-on

voice._about: his voice lines: espeak-ng's Klatt formant synthesis (the family of 1980s synthesizer his was from; not his own voice, whose emulator isn't public) shaped by ffmpeg, then [Voice] in the skater's ini (pc/voice.h in the port). make_voice.py writes build/voice/<model>_<line>.wav; change a line or a setting and rebuild

espeak._args: espeak-ng options: -v voice+variant, -s words a minute, -p pitch 0-99, -a amplitude, -g gap between words (10 ms units)

voice._filter: ffmpeg audio filter after synthesis (the old hardware's narrow band)

lines.start: However difficult life may seem, there is always something you can do and succeed at.
lines.stars: One step closer to the stars.
lines.adapt: Intelligence is the ability to adapt to change.
lines.imperfection: Without imperfection, we would not exist.

voice._events: which lines play when: Start (a run starts), Trick (a trick scores, at TrickChance percent, Gap seconds after the last line), Bail (he bails), AfterBail (after the Bail line, at AfterBailChance percent); Volume is percent of the sound effects
